story.title: Escalating Ground Fighting in Yemen Results in Over 60 Deaths, Including Civilians
story.summary: Clashes between Yemen's Saudi-backed government forces and Houthi rebels have resulted in at least 60 fatalities, including civilians. The fighting, which is among the deadliest in recent years, occurred during a Houthi offensive on the western coast. Additionally, a missile strike by the Houthis near Taiz killed at least four civilians amid ongoing violence and displacement in the region.

timeline_highlights.title: Ukrainian Drone Strike Causes Major Fire at Saint Petersburg Warehouse
timeline_highlights.summary: A Ukrainian drone strike ignited a significant fire at a Wildberries warehouse near Saint Petersburg on July 24. The blaze produced thick smoke that spread across the city and led to temporary disruptions at Pulkovo Airport, as reported by Russian authorities.

timeline_highlights.title: Russia Claims Strikes on Ukrainian Infrastructure Amid Drone Attacks
timeline_highlights.summary: Russia reported that it targeted Ukrainian railway and port facilities in recent strikes. In response, Ukrainian drones struck a major oil refinery deep inside Russia, igniting a fire at the facility. These developments occur amid ongoing military actions as both nations continue to engage in conflict over territory and resources.

timeline_highlights.title: Civilian Casualties in Ukraine Reach Highest Monthly Level Since 2022
timeline_highlights.summary: UN monitors report that civilian casualties in Ukraine have surged to their highest monthly level since the onset of Russia's full-scale invasion. Recent attacks, including a drone strike, have contributed to this alarming trend, resulting in multiple fatalities, including a woman and her 9-year-old son. July has been noted as the deadliest month for Ukrainian civilians since the early days of the conflict.
key_facts: Civilian casualties in Ukraine reached the highest monthly level since the start of the war.

timeline_highlights.title: Ukraine Conducts Major Drone Attack on Moscow Amid Ongoing Conflict
timeline_highlights.summary: Ukraine launched a significant drone attack on Moscow, deploying hundreds of drones and reportedly killing at least six people. Russian authorities claimed to have shot down at least 201 drones during the assault. The attack is described as one of the largest aerial offensives by Ukraine since the beginning of the conflict, with fires reported at a logistics hub near the capital. Concurrently, Russian strikes on Ukraine resulted in additional casualties.

At least six fatalities reported in Russia due to the drone attack.

related_stories.title: U.S. Military Destroys Three Iranian Oil Tankers Following Attacks
related_stories.summary: The U.S. military reported that it destroyed three Iranian oil tankers, including the M/T Downy and M/T Stark 1, after Iran launched ballistic missile attacks targeting U.S. naval vessels. The U.S. Central Command stated that the attacks on the tankers were a response to Iran's failed missile strikes against a U.S. aircraft carrier and a destroyer.

related_stories.title: US Ambassador Visits Palestinian Town Affected by Settler Violence
related_stories.summary: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee visited the Palestinian town of Turmus Ayya in the Israeli-occupied West Bank, which has faced repeated violence from Israeli settlers. During his visit, Huckabee emphasized the need for the Israeli government to address the issue of violent settlers.

related_stories.title: Resignations at Reform UK Amid Allegations of Foreign Funding Scandal
related_stories.summary: Two senior officials from the Reform UK party stepped down following an undercover investigation that allegedly revealed discussions about soliciting foreign funding for party activities, which is illegal under UK law. The investigation suggested a potential £500,000 donation from a US donor. Reform UK has denied any wrongdoing, claiming it was a victim of a hoax.
